email_subject: Application - Communications Intern at MedTech Europe
email_body:
Dear Davidson Leite,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern role at MedTech Europe. I have a proven record of creating clear, compelling content for complex subjects: I built a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, wrote and edited content for a multilingual site (English, Dutch, French), and ran a Google Ads test that achieved a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I am digital savvy, meticulous, and proactive—exactly the qualities you need for media monitoring, newsletter support, and social media content.

MedTech Europe's mission to advance medical technologies resonates with me. I have a background in healthcare tech (front-end developer for a healthcare web app) and I follow the EU healthcare landscape closely. I am fluent in English and comfortable with Mailchimp, WordPress, and SharePoint. I have my own car, so commuting to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I would familiarise myself with your media monitoring tools and newsletter workflows, and start contributing content ideas for social media. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your communications team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

## SUMMARY
I am a digital marketer who judges a website by the customers it brings in. I have built and managed WordPress sites, created content for online audiences, and run SEO and Google Ads campaigns. At Episto I help clients rank for buyer searches, and as a freelancer I bring in my own clients and present results to their teams. My front-end background means I can build landing pages and read the data without waiting on anyone. I am analytical, eager to learn, and want to use my writing and digital skills to support communications that reach the right people.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present

- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant

- **Growth & sales:** lead generation, landing pages, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, A/B testing
- **SEO & marketing:** content marketing, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
- **Data & tools:** WordPress/Elementor, GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT
